Eleanor — quick add from our side. We've seen this behavior before when session-affinity cookies or a cached relayState tie the browser to a different Ariba tenant. Typical quick checks:

- Try in a private/incognito window (Stephanie asked this but worth reiterating).
- Clear cookies for ariba.net / supplier.ariba.com and retry.
- If possible, paste the full redirect URL you land on (don't worry about sharing it here; you can drop it to me directly).

If those don't work, Jordan and Rafael, can you check whether the invite token we generated points to the correct tenant mapping? I'll attach a recent session trace that shows the redirect chain we expect vs. what Axon reported.

Attachments: session-trace.txt

Thanks — we'll get this unstuck.

Ben Carter

Redwood Inference

Eleanor — thanks for the redirect dump, that helps. I'm escalating this to Ariba support (cc'd) and opening an internal ticket (JIRA SUPP-2147). Action plan: 

1) Ariba support — can you confirm whether the invite token is bound to the correct tenant ID or if there's a stale relayState mapping causing cross-tenant bounce? Please prioritize and advise ETA.
2) In parallel, Rafael/Jordan — please verify the token we issued for Axon Corp maps to tenant ID 0xA3F2 and hasn't been reissued to a staging tenant. If you find a mismatch, please prepare a token reissue and send a plain-text accept URL we can share with Axon's procurement team.
3) Eleanor — as a short-term workaround, if Ariba can accept a manual supplier setup (we can attach the W-9 and vendor profile) we will process the PO manually — let us know if your AP team can accept that.

I'll follow up on the JIRA and update the HubSpot deal. Thanks everyone for the quick responses.

Marissa Cole
